about: Tailscale address and ICE candidate filters from src/renderer/shared/rtc.js. protocol: the constants they derive from (TS_IPV6_PREFIX = the first 48 bits). Regenerate with node scripts/make-mobile-fixtures.js.

candidateAddress.about: candidateAddress(line) -> the 5th field of "candidate:<foundation> <component> <transport> <priority> <address> <port> typ <type> ...", or null. An "a=" prefix is allowed; fields split on any whitespace run; at most 2048 characters.

isAllowedCandidate.about: isAllowedCandidate(init) -> bool. null, a missing or empty candidate (end of candidates) -> true; otherwise candidateAddress must be a Tailscale IP.

args.candidate: candidate:1 1 udp 2122260223 fd7a:115c:a1e0::1234 47810 typ host generation 0
candidate:5 1 udp 1686052607 203.0.113.9 47814 typ srflx raddr 0.0.0.0 rport 0

isTailscaleAddress.about: isTailscaleAddress(addr) -> bool: inside 100.64.0.0/10 or fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48. Brackets, a zone id, surrounding spaces and IPv4-mapped IPv6 are accepted; names never are.

cases.note: a port is not part of an address
a zone id is stripped from IPv4 too
